cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.

cumulative_refill_evidence.assumption: Starts at zero storage at the first retained modeled event, subtracts the transferred Zero G stable-lower-MX2001 + seasonal Moab ETo loss between storms and through the present, then adds modeled runoff and caps storage at 100%.
